approval_reference: Founder activation decision FORA-ACT-REV-2026-001 supplied in the Codex task on 2026-07-19
conditions: Activation must follow CONTROLLED_ACTIVATION_PROCEDURE.md without enlargement of scope.
Activation must be performed from a clean checkout of the approved branch and exact reviewed commits.
All eight registered review agents must pass the required response-only post-activation canaries.
The calibration-only es_runtime_canary.toml must remain separate from the eight registered review roles.
No production credentials, production routes, production data, provider writes, deployment capability, or production access may be present.
The observed noninteractive approval_policy=never must not be interpreted as permission or authority. Any action outside the expressly authorized activation sequence must fail closed.
workspace-write must not be treated as a role-specific path allowlist. Output boundaries must remain procedurally constrained and verified after activation.
All commands, prompts, outputs, provenance, failures, retries, checksums, and final results must be preserved.
Any failed activation or canary must result in ACTIVATION_BLOCKED_OR_ROLLBACK_REQUIRED and no further agent use.
Substantive Founder-Orchestrated Review may not commence without a separate Founder authorization.
No pull request, merge, default-branch modification, tag, release, or deployment is authorized.
rationale: The installation and reconciliation evidence demonstrate sufficient technical readiness for controlled operational activation. Activation remains distinct from substantive review commencement, implementation authorization, production authority, and external assurance.
